node: AI rack power conversion from grid input to point-of-load
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for AI rack power conversion with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: Monolithic Power Systems as the high-attention point-of-load/module leader tied to AI data-center power solutions. Underfollowed/discovery lane: Vicor, Navitas, and Power Integrations as narrower power-conversion or GaN/SiC specialists with credible 800V or high-voltage AI-rack relevance, but differing evidence quality. Key chokepoint logic: NVIDIA-backed 800VDC architectures shift value toward suppliers that can convert efficiently from facility/rack-level high voltage down to intermediate and chip-proximate rails. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
